text:
Evan: Quick heads-up — the Vellum LoRA merge (cust/vellum:resp-lora) on int4 quant shows a clear spike in hallucinations in the quick-eval pack. Putting short summary and a couple examples below.

Leila: How big a spike? any particular subset failing? :eyes:

Evan: FP16 baseline on the same adapter+prompts: 94% pass on our QA checks. Int4 merge dropped to ~79% pass, failure concentrated on invoice/date/amount extraction prompts.

Evan: Eval command we ran:
```
./eval_pack --model /models/vellum/resp-lora:int4 --prompts quick-eval-vellum.json --batch 32 --out results.jsonl
```

Evan: Sample failing outputs (prompt -> model answer):
```
PROMPT: "Extract invoice total and date: \nInvoice: #12345\nTotal: $2,500\nDate: 05/2024"
MODEL: "Total: $2,500.00. Date: 05/2025"  <-- wrong year (hallucination)

PROMPT: "What is the due date?\nInvoice 987\nDue:" 
MODEL: "Due: 30 days from now"  <-- hallucinated relative date
```

Sasha: Hmm. Could be quantization mis-scaling of final layers or a tokenizer offset. Did you compare logits/topk distributions between fp16 and int4 on these examples?

Evan: Not yet. I grabbed the outputs only. I can dump logits if that's helpful.

Leila: Also check if KV-cache handling changed in the int4 runtime — we saw subtle context misalignment once before when rolling custom kernel.

Mike: I'll run a focused smoke with logits + diff tooling on dedicated infra (dedicated-1 pool). Will try both disabling prefix cache and running with gquant group=64.

deploy-bot: Job queued: eval-job-88421 on pool dedicated-1. ETA ~ 12m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Mike: started the run. will post results in this thread.

Evan: thanks — attaching the quick-eval pack link: https://internal.redwood/vellum/eval/quickpack/633000

Sasha: If the logits diff shows peaky tail differences, try toggling matmul fallback (env var RL_MATMUL_FALLBACK=1) and re-run. Also check tokenizer special token mapping — sometimes LoRA merges shift special-token ids.

Leila: Also add a small sanity: run the baseline fp16 model but with the int4 tokenizer files (to see if tokenizer mapping causes it). Quick 50-sample run.

Evan: On it. Will update with the logs and a short table of failing prompts vs fp16 next.

Mike: first smoke done: short summary: 80% pass on int4 w/ default; enabling matmul fallback -> 90% pass; group-64 quant -> 88% pass. Pasting logs + diff snippets.

Mike: log snippet:
```
[eval] prompt_id=42 pass=false fp16_prob=0.92 int4_prob=0.51 kl_div=2.3
[eval] prompt_id=43 pass=false fp16_top1=0.87 int4_top1=0.12
```

Evan: wow, matmul fallback improved a lot. :thumbsup: Could be kernel selection issue. Next steps: coordinate with eng-runtime to investigate kernel choice for final layers; meanwhile propose shipping int4 with matmul fallback for Vellum as temporary mitigation.

Leila: Agree. File a short rollback/mitigation note for the customer and schedule a deeper root-cause task.

Sasha: I'll open an infra issue and tag runtime folks. Thanks all.

Evan: +1. I'll prepare the customer note draft.

Leila: Thanks team :pray:
